name: lokey-monorepo
description: Convenience scripts for the lokey repo (the app itself lives in ./app, the native sidecar in ./native/Lokey.Host)

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm --dir app install && dotnet build native/Lokey.Host -c Release
scripts.verify: pnpm --dir app typecheck && pnpm --dir app build && dotnet build native/Lokey.Host -c Release
